description: This file defines the AttendanceRecord entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties representing punch-in and punch-out times, notes, time zones, and status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing an attendance record with punch-in and punch-out details, associated with an employee, and containing constants for different states.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this attendance record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC punch-in time.

methods.name: setPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the UTC punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchInNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset for punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-local punch-in time.

methods.name: setPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC punch-out time.

methods.name: setPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the UTC punch-out time.

methods.name: getPunchOutNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset for punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset for punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-local punch-out time.

methods.name: setPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-out time.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name for punch-out.
